title: barista config.json
description: barista settings; used at user level (~/.barista/config.json) and workspace level (<workspace>/.barista/config.json), workspace overrides user

parallel.description: Max concurrent repo operations; overridden by --parallel

color.description: Color output mode; NO_COLOR env var takes precedence over everything

properties.description: Free-form domain extension settings keyed by dotted names; maven.* keys are consulted at workspace level only

maven.jdk.description: Workspace override of the JDK spec used to run maven (overrides ~/.barista/maven.json jdk); workspace level only

maven.default.description: Workspace override of the default maven installation name (overrides ~/.barista/maven.json default); workspace level only
